//: Token-enforcement lint (docs/styling-conventions.md). Design values come from the --sys-* tokens of libs/ui/tokens: typography via the --sys-font-* text roles (the role carries its weight; a literal 400-700 is the one sanctioned override), tracking via --sys-tracking-*, stacking via the --sys-layer-* scale, motion via the --sys-motion-* tokens. The @font-face weight range of a variable face (`100 900`) is a descriptor, not a design value. Deliberate one-offs carry inline stylelint-disable comments naming their rationale.

overrides.//: The token sources themselves (tokens.css, the two theme files, reset.css, reduced-motion.css) and every DS and feature stylesheet are exempt from the two value lists. The token files define the values; the DS and feature sheets still carry ~70 literal metrics this list would refuse (icon glyph sizes through component custom properties, a few rem font sizes and line heights, keyframe shorthands with literal durations) — they are governed by their co-located CSS and the accent specs of libs/ui/tokens until those move onto tokens, and then the trees leave this override. The two app stylesheets and the showcase are governed by the lists above. The icon-font ban (font-family) is re-declared here because this override replaces the whole rule: no stylesheet may summon Material Symbols — icons are inline SVG from libs/ui/icons.
